note: Project-only status, newest first. This page replaces routine chat reports. It is edited by hand when the project changes; nothing here is a live feed, and it does not claim live, unattended or independently verified operation.

items.title: Verifier qualification test failed
items.body: One request was sent to the free route for the verifier model. The provider answered HTTP 404 and returned no verdict. It was not retried, no other role ran, and Ryan's review did not run. The runner is paused by its own halt record, and that test window is stopped. Cause is unknown: the model is listed as free but was not callable as requested. This is not a model-quality result. The full team is not autonomous. No model or role is qualified.

items.title: Route research closed: no qualified verifier route
items.body: Read-only checks of public documentation found no verifier route that is both callable and independent. One other candidate has unresolved upstream terms and another has no evidenced output ceiling, so neither is qualified. One request remains under the current controls, which is not enough for a verifier plus Ryan's review. Next: pick a callable, independent route through a reviewed change. No requests, limits or assignments were changed.

items.title: Handover tooling built and tested offline
items.body: Added a setup guide (HANDOVER.md), a read-only environment and state checker (32 passing checks) and a fresh-environment script. The script clones the repository, builds a new virtual environment with the pinned packages, scrubs the environment and runs all 29 test files: all exit 0 with no network request. This was tested in one sandbox only, not on another machine or with another AI operator, so the handover is not yet proven end to end. Secrets stay out of Git and nothing transfers from the previous operator's accounts; a new operator supplies their own keys. The previous operator's chat history and prompts are not exported. Private run records go over only by a separate private route, if at all. Nothing has been transferred to anyone.

items.title: Known test environment dependency
items.body: live_entry_test.py fails 6 checks when HOME is not the account home, because the reserve preflight guard refuses a different HOME. With the right HOME it passes 57 of 57. The test was not edited; the guide states the requirement.

items.title: Public code is not the latest execution state
items.body: The public branch holds code and tests. The latest run records, including the failed verifier test and the paused runner, are in a private runner folder and are not in Git. A new operator reads that state with the read-only state checker, and does not reset it: a halt or unknown outcome stands.
